note: Pinned grammar and shape aliases; no production JavaScript dependency.

sources.licence: CC-BY-4.0 data; BSD-3-Clause when incorporated into source code

reference.network: loopback module loading only; external requests aborted

boundedFlavor.depth: Limits.metadata_depth: 1..256, default 256; independent of diagram depth
boundedFlavor.budget: Limits.metadata_work: positive, default 1000000; also limited by remaining reader work

yaml.preflight: Alias-free physical-depth pass, then event-based logical alias depth and expansion work before recursive dependency weighing. JSON_SCHEMA numeric normalization preserves NaN/infinities, binary integers and overflowing-literal strings.
yaml.productionUse: pure shape-data YAML normalization only; no filesystem/process/network

normalization: The first completed subgraph registration keeps its label, direction and position; repeated IDs merge only unowned members.
Canonical metadata is typed Json, with stable key ordering; CST retains original YAML/anchors/comments.
One-sided source markers stay explicit in the project structural policy even when the upstream database type is arrow_open.
Modern metadata labels preserve raw YAML scalar whitespace and outer quotes; classic text uses the pinned text-object trimming policy.
Canonical shape data uses block YAML and Unicode escapes for literal quotes/braces, following the native shape-data lexer.
BOM and JavaScript SPACE separators preserve the source CST and UTF-16 offsets.
Truthy image/icon properties determine effective asset identity even with a declared vector shape; native asset requirements fail explicitly without fetching.
